notes.title: Fixes and minor balance changes!
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.3.8[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
-Increased the Runic Essence bonus from Stellar Stars
-Doubled the bonus from Paradox Anchors!

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
-Achievements get a notification icon when you trigger them
-Fixed Steam Achievements sometimes not triggering
-Fixed Stellar Stars not boosting Chaotic Essence Gain
-Fixed the text on the Chalice not updating right away!

notes.title: Mirror Merging + bug fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]v1.3.0[/b]
[i]*Changes*[/i]
-You can now Merge Mirrors of Remembrance into Mirrors of Sight or Paradox Anchors! :-O
-The Rings of Sight will not be refunded when Respeccing
-The Ring of Second Sight is slightly cheaper

[i]*Fixes*[/i]
-Fixed a bug with Respeccing!
-Fixed a few typos!
-The description of Stars now properly reflects the bonus from the Ring of Stars!

notes.title: Post-launch QoL and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Thanks to all for the successful launch! This update brings some QoL and bug fixes.

[b]Changes[/b]
-Due to popular demand, items will now retain their position through Awakenings! This can be disabled in the options for randomized item positions.
-Changed "Essence" to "Runic Essence" on the Magnificent Star description for clarity
-There is a new option to only open a window if you can't upgrade the item (use with Upgrade on Tap)
-There is a new option to adjust the period over which "Recent Gains" tracks
-There is a new option to enable "High Contrast Numbers" on items. It's a work in progress!
-There is a new option to Pause the Game!
-Added a note for new players suggesting the "upgrade on tap" option
-Revised the desc of Bag of Holding to (hopefully) be clearer!

[b]Fixes[/b]
-Lowered initial volume level
-The volume settings will be properly used when reloading the game
-Fixed cloud login
-Remove the random Gem gain when first entering username
-Fixed the description of the Ring of Chaos (should say 0.1%)
-Fixed a typo

Yahoo! :-D
